title: tradeframe
summary: Program.Trade.cs implements the trade loop end to end: SMSG_TRADE_STATUS state machine (begin/open/accept/unaccept-reset/close codes), SMSG_TRADE_STATUS_EXTENDED item+gold snapshots for both sides, the UI-TradeFrame four-piece shell, both names, 7 slots per side with click-to-place (CMSG_SET_TRADE_ITEM) and click-to-clear (CMSG_CLEAR_TRADE_ITEM), gold entry (CMSG_SET_TRADE_GOLD), Trade/Cancel buttons (CMSG_ACCEPT_TRADE / CMSG_CANCEL_TRADE), partner-accepted indicator, and the incoming-trade invitation popup with CMSG_BEGIN_TRADE.

openItems.text: Slot 7 is drawn identically to slots 1-6: the ref separates the 7th 'Will not be traded' slot with its own label/highlight region
Stack counts are not rendered on trade-slot icons
No un-accept path: after clicking Trade the button disables; the ref lets the player retract (CMSG_UNACCEPT_TRADE) - MSUI only resets accept on an item/gold change
No item tooltips on trade slots (GetTradePlayerItem/GetTradeTargetItem tooltip)
No partner portrait on the window ring; partner-accept is a text line rather than the ref's highlight glow over the partner column
